# How to remake a movie scene with new characters using AI (motion control)

**A reference clip, photos of your cast and a replace-keep-never prompt become your version with the original motion, timing and camera.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_bdf35f76a7dd.webp" alt="An old wizard in a blue star robe does a goofy dance in a retro kitchen: an invented character recast into a stock dance clip, same moves, same room." width="480"></p>

Remake a known scene with a new cast: give a video model a short reference clip (a film scene, a dance, a fight, a news shot, a meme) plus photos of your own characters and a "replace, keep, never" prompt, and get your version with the motion, timing, camera and cuts of the original. Covers trimming the clip, character references, the recast prompt, new dialogue, the first-frame lock, the motion-only plate (greyscale or depth), three varg routes (Seedance 2.5 with a video reference, MiniMax H3 Max Recast, Wan 3), a frame-by-frame check against the source and a stacked original-vs-remake export. Use when someone wants a parody of a movie scene, "this scene but with X", a character swap, a motion-control remake, a live-action version of a game or anime scene, a meme recast, or asks how the Higgsfield Genjutsu / Seedance video-reference remakes on X are made. For the joke, format choice and the rules for real people use ai-parody-video; for a talking monologue use multi-angle-monologue.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill scene-recast-video                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills scene-recast-video --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 82 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | 5-30 s remake MP4 and a stacked original-vs-remake MP4 |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | measured: $3.00 for a 10 s Recast at 768p, $2.48 for 10 s on Seedance 2.5 at 480p |
| Uses | varg API, Seedance 2.5, MiniMax H3 Max Recast, Wan 3, FFmpeg |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Remake ./scene.mp4 with the two characters in ./cast/, same motion and camera, 16:9, 480p draft first"
- "Swap the dancer in this clip for my character sheet and stack the original over the remake"
- "My recast keeps the original actor's costume. Fix it with a motion-only plate"
